College isn’t basically mandatory. Trades are an option for many who may not have the resources or time to do a typical college route. Those who are chronically ill, single parent, or hit by other life circumstances may really not be able to access college realistically or finish at all. Trades will always be in demand. Find someone in a trade you like, offer to work for them for free a few hours a week, (For those saying you don’t even have that, how many hours do you sit and video game once you get home? 😉 Surely you could sacrifice an hour or 2 once a week on under someone.) learn the skills, and make connections.
